race.comment: NAILS MURPHY (6) hit the line well fresh from the back and then progressed nicely last time when just missing the bob to the red-hot Express Payment. Loves the mile and is drawn perfectly. Can go one better. BRINDAVAN (2) is the obvious danger, having won well first-up at Doomben before being pipped at this venue as a well-supported favourite, with Ryan Maloney reuniting a plus. CUNNAMULLA FELLA (5) also comes through the Express Payment race where the three of them went locked to the line. Certainly doesn't lack fitness and has the peaks to get the job done. ALL KINDS OF FOLK (9) resumes from a short break off a Randwick win on heavy ground and a solid Doomben trial. Gets in at featherweight and takes benefit from Thompson's booking. AKKADIAN EMPEROR (8) will be looking for further but two lead-up trials should have him forward enough to give supporters a sight under the light weight.
